question: Can the already-verified canonical single-venue depth and tape streams produce deterministic causal measurements for the Level 2 and tape concepts Ross teaches, without fitting a threshold or creating trading authority?

source_evidence.title: Level 2 for Day Trading (+$65k in 2hrs After Spotting Hidden Buyers)
supported_concepts: executed volume relative to displayed liquidity
price failing to advance despite aggressive buying
price failing to decline despite aggressive selling
hidden buyer or seller is inferred from observable conflict rather than directly observed

source_evidence.title: Growing a $2k Account to $65,662.04 in 30 Days (My Day Trading Strategy)
The Micro Pullback Trading Strategy (Small Account Challenge)
supported_concepts: stacked bid and green prints are discretionary support context rather than a lower chart trigger

engineering_horizons.selection_basis: Symmetric one-, five-, and ten-second engineering coverage ending at the causal snapshot time. All horizons are emitted together; none is selected as best.

feature_mechanics.mechanic: Emit the best bid, best ask, spread, and up to ten venue-scoped displayed price levels with exact size and order count.
feature_mechanics.unavailable_when: the initial book state is incomplete

feature_mechanics.mechanic: Emit bid minus ask displayed depth as an integer numerator and bid plus ask depth as its denominator over the covered levels.
feature_mechanics.unavailable_when: the book is incomplete or one-sided

feature_mechanics.mechanic: Match later same-price same-side displayed additions against earlier in-window depletions in FIFO order and split shares replenished after fills from shares replenished after non-execution removals. Emit the symmetric bid measurement as engineering context.

Emit event, share, and price-notional numerators by buy, sell, and unknown aggressor side for every registered window. Preserve unknown explicitly and fail the affected tape family closed when a correction or cancellation is present.
feature_mechanics.unavailable_when: a correction or cancellation occurs in the window

feature_mechanics.mechanic: Emit distinct observed aggressive trade prices and their price span. Do not claim that every intervening displayed book level was consumed.
feature_mechanics.unavailable_when: a correction or cancellation occurs in the window

feature_mechanics.mechanic: Emit executed shares, first-to-last price progress, and same-window displayed replenishment separately. Ratios remain integer numerator and denominator components. Hidden liquidity is a possible proxy interpretation, never proof.
feature_mechanics.unavailable_when: there are no eligible tape events or a correction/cancellation occurs

feature_mechanics.mechanic: Emit add, cancel, fill, and modify event and share counts by book side without assigning intent or labeling spoofing.
When a causal breakout level is supplied by the chart setup, emit buy events and shares at or above it, maximum and last progress, and post-cross selling below it. Do not emit a pass/fail decision.
feature_mechanics.unavailable_when: the breakout level is absent, tape is empty, or a correction/cancellation occurs

feature_mechanics.mechanic: For each explicitly supplied hypothetical order size, walk no more than ten displayed levels and report filled, unfilled, worst-price, notional, and rational average-price components. Do not assume queue priority or hidden liquidity.

explicitly_not_in_scope: using the four engineering cases to choose a feature window or threshold
calling a hidden buyer, hidden seller, iceberg, or spoofing event proven
claiming Nasdaq venue depth is consolidated national Level 2
changing Micro-v0.1 entry, exit, sizing, or account policy
spending Databento credit before a separately authorized one-shot contract
